title: Shift CAD Forest Reference Origin
description: The CAD concrete-forest example reference plane must be shifted by about 50% to the right and 50% to the front so it aligns with the 3D model. Update the hardcoded CadReference origin in forest_references_for_model_definitions (+half widthWorld on X, +half plane height on Y).
summary: Shifted the CAD concrete-forest example reference plane by +50% of its world width to the right (+X) and +50% of its world depth to the front (+Y). Origin moves from [-24, -18, z] to [-13, ≈-12.68, z] via forest_reference_origin(), using the PNG aspect (1430×692) for depth. Extended forest_references_sit_at_authored_slab_elevation to assert the new XY placement; cargo test passed.
